authoring.calibrationRequired: Export exact rest rig; compute local calibrated upper/lower axes/signs and nonzero downward upperRestRotation. Keep source fingers rigid.
authoring.wingOwnership: Two independently authored original-index masks attached directly to Body; no distance fallback or arm ownership.
